subject: Humanities
title: Evidence and a qualified claim
prompt: Explain why one successful school tutoring trial supports a qualified claim about that setting, not a universal claim that tutoring always works.
learner: Can distinguish a claim from an example.
styleBrief: Argument annotation: highlight the evidence, connect it to a bounded claim, then mark the unsupported generalization.
criteria: One trial cannot establish that tutoring always works everywhere.
Keep the example hypothetical; do not invent study results.
Use motion to reveal the scope of inference.
